intended: all s: Search, u: Unit | (s in Trial and s->u in Leave.rel) implies (u in Held and s->u not in Pose.units and (all v: Unit | (v in Held and v != u) implies s->v in Pose.units))
why: The scenario c is bound around the claim but used only in the condition, so the claim binds only for a trial that requires some scenario to happen. A trial that leaves out an unheld unit, or drops other held units, but poses no scenario satisfies the formula while breaking the claim that a trial leaves out one held unit and keeps the rest.
